purpose: Reviewed public metadata for source-level QA by independent lane; staging and counts do not mean these records are available in the production facility-risk service.
caveats: Each row represents a distinct official-source table, reported notification, chemical form, county observation, wildfire pixel or publisher aggregate. Do NOT sum accepted counts as unique facilities, accidents, outages or insured claims.

Source-only SQLite indexed in disposable GitHub Actions staging differs from an installed authenticated durable private index. The four ingestion lane PRs remain DRAFT, not yet merged. Production deployed and approved physical-site matches = 0 for all streams.

Some source products overlap (e.g., ORNL current snapshots and mirrors, NRC/CSB match candidates, CSB quarterly revisions). Never deduplicate or join them into a verified event or site without manual independent evidence.
Source blocks (PHMSA original incident data, SEC original filings, restricted RMP plans) and geographic/snapshot gaps mean UNKNOWN coverage, not zero risk.
Identity, location accuracy, policy coverage, damage, financial impact and paid insurance claims require separate verifiable evidence before underwriting use.
